title: How Intermittent Fasting Can Help You Lose Weight - Healthline
text: How Intermittent Fasting Can Help You Lose Weight - Healthline. Intermittent fasting is an eating pattern that involves regular, short-term fasts, and you may wonder whether it aids weight loss. Learn common fasting plans and their benefits

title: Diet Review: Intermittent Fasting for Weight Loss - The Nutrition Source
text: Diet Review: Intermittent Fasting for Weight Loss - The Nutrition Source. A systematic review of 40 studies found that intermittent fasting was effective for weight loss, with a typical loss of 7-11 pounds over 10 weeks. [2] There was much variability in the studies, ranging in size from 4 to 334 subjects, and followed from 2 to 104 weeks
